content_html_sanitized:
Canadian farmers expect to be planting seeds this spring for Ontario's first commercial hemp crop in 50 years.Canadian Health Minister Allan Rock released proposed regulations on the weekend for a commercial hemp industry in southwestern Ontario. Members of Parliament from the area have been lobbying for action on the crop for years. Rose-Marie Ur, who represents Lambton-Kent-Middlesex riding in southwestern Ontario, said the final regulations should be proclaimed in time for spring planting.

"Unless there's major, major problems, we still can meet our spring deadline," she said.

"Not only is it a good alternative crop, it has been a crop in the Lambton part of my riding in the earlier years," said Ur. "It's not like we're-inventing the wheel here."She said Ontario will be several years ahead of jurisdictions in the United States in hemp production, and that will provide millions in export revenue for Canada. In the US the Drug Enforcement Administration has agents whose job it is to lie to state legislatures in order to suppress the cultivation of hemp here. A recent statement by the Drug Czar's office claimed that it would not be economical to grow hemp in America. Presumably Canadian farmers like to lose money.

Farmers grew hemp in the Forest area in Lambton County in the 1940s but the prohibition of "marijuana" was used to "regulate" hemp production out of existence. Hemp, grown for fiber and oil, is essentially the same as other cannabis plants grown for the production of marijuana, however the strains are not chosen for THC content. Also, growing them very close together, has the effect of limiting flower production. Many countries require the use of special low THC strains, but some do not. In reality, diversion from hemp production is not likely to have any significant impact on marijuana supplies, but knowledge about the plant is a threat to the credibility of the propaganda necessary to justify the arrests of over six hundred thousand Americans every year and the continued suppression of medical cannabis.
